statement: These thresholds were frozen BEFORE any R15-trained checkpoint existed and before any VLA DEV prediction was computed. They are not to be adjusted after seeing a VLA DEV score.

dev_cohort.frame_rule: history-safe t in [2, T-2], deterministically chosen

conditions: loss finite at every recorded step
every decoded 14D command inside the joint box
a clear signal over the zero-step model and over identity A=S: DEV macro L1 must be strictly lower than identity_A=S macro L1 (0.007733860024018213)
no total collapse: still_action_rate < 1.0 and magnitude_ratio within [0.2, 5.0]
G4_300.action_if_fail: stop formal training, diagnose (labels/shift/vision/grad/lr), do not add steps

conditions: DEV macro physical L1 improves at least 5 percent versus constant velocity (target <= 0.002005 from 0.002110)
OR the same 5% test passes in at least 3 of 4 pre-registered motion strata (strata are the DEV |V| quartiles of the frozen gate frames)
magnitude ratio and sign agreement not worse than CV by more than 20 percent
G5_1000.action_if_fail: stop at 1000, keep the checkpoint, diagnose; never train to 3000 blindly

conditions: same-sample fair metrics for every reported stage
the reported checkpoint is the DEV-best among 300/1000/3000
the new FINAL data remains untouched
G6_3000.action_if_fail: report FAILED_CAPABILITY with the real numbers

notes: Offline L1 is not the closed-loop success rate.
constant velocity is a strong baseline on Push-T; a model that cannot beat it has not learned the task.

errata.author: executor (DeepSeek R15-R23), after audit PR#21
errata.scope: METRIC DEFINITIONS AND REPORTING ONLY. No threshold, cohort, frame list, seed, baseline number or gate action changed.

original_preserved.note: this block is appended; nothing above it was edited

items.defect: sign_agreement and magnitude_ratio were computed on the ABSOLUTE joint position

new_definition.delta: dA = A_hat - S_t versus dA_true = A_t - S_t; sign_agreement/magnitude_ratio are now computed here (unprefixed keys)
new_definition.residual: R = (A - S) - V with V_t = S_t - S_{t-1}; residual_sign_agreement / residual_magnitude_ratio report the same tests on R
new_definition.legacy: absolute_sign_agreement / absolute_magnitude_ratio keep the v1 numbers for continuity but are NOT gated

items.why: Push-T joint positions hover around a working point, so absolute-position signs agree ~99.6% of the time for any smooth predictor; that number says nothing about the commanded motion. The same-sample delta-based sign agreement is 0.786 for constant velocity and 0.690 for VLA@300.

items.defect: a single ambiguous joint_clip_rate was reported while 6.03% of decoded coordinates were outside the joint box, and the G4 'inside the joint box' condition was judged without stating which vector was checked

new_definition.raw: the decoded vector exactly as emitted by the 14-token decoder; raw_oob_coord_rate, raw_oob_frame_rate, raw_oob_coord_count, raw_oob_max_excursion are required reported statistics
new_definition.safe: the same vector after the coordinate-wise clamp to [amin, amax]; this is what the policy server sends, and it is what the gate is judged on
new_definition.legacy_alias: joint_clip_rate is kept as an alias of raw_oob_coord_rate so old tables cannot be misread as a SAFE statistic

items.what: G4_300 is re-run with the v2 definitions on the archived step-300 prediction archive (runs/r15_stage_300_20261021T030423Z/preds_dev300.npz, 32 frozen frames)
items.honest_reading: the 6.03% figure is a RAW coordinate rate on 56% of frames, but the excursions are tiny (max 0.03 rad, mean clamp 7e-5), so SAFE does not hide a safety problem; it does change the headline number by ~3%
items.note: under the SAFE口径 VLA@300 (0.0020678) is still ~1.0% WORSE than constant velocity (0.0020475), i.e. G4 passes (signal over identity, no collapse, safe) but G5 cannot pass at 300 by construction

v1_evaluator_snapshot.why: byte copy of diagnostics/r15_dev_eval.py at commit 2598962, i.e. the code that produced cv_macro_l1=0.002110443303536158 and vla_macro_l1=0.002134356982423924; the working-tree evaluator is now v2 so the v1 number must stay reproducible

freeze_evidence.statement: the pre-registration was committed before any VLA DEV prediction existed; the first DEV 7B inference ran 03:34:07Z-03:39:30Z (runs/r15_dev_step300/devpreds.log)

written_utc_caveat.problem: the original written_utc field (2026-10-21T11:05:00Z) is inconsistent with both the file mtime and the commit time 02:59:53Z
written_utc_caveat.resolution: the field is NOT admissible freeze evidence; the git commit timestamp and the absence of any earlier DEV prediction are. Found by audit lane H; kept as-is rather than silently edited.

items.integrity_note: the audit verified by diffing the working tree against the HEAD blob that no threshold, cohort, seed, frame list or gate action was modified; only the errata block is added

sampling_and_clip_contract.frame_sampling: one deterministic greedy decode per frozen DEV frame; frozen frame list = 16 DEV episodes x 2 frames, seed 0, history-safe t in [2, T-2]
sampling_and_clip_contract.decode: greedy argmax restricted to tokens 31744..31999, 14 autoregressive action tokens, STOP(2) not used for the command vector
sampling_and_clip_contract.aggregation: episode-macro mean of per-frame physical joint L1 (macro, not pooled); pooled reported alongside
sampling_and_clip_contract.clip: coordinate-wise clamp of the 14D command to [amin, amax] from data/push_T_bounds.npz (sha256 5c567abcd5e6afa9e579038bb2d3cd1e9919e8e439ab4cb2ddadbcd8aa9f7855); no temporal filter, no rate limit for these offline numbers, no test-time augmentation, no best-of-n

errata.g5_absolute_target_note: recorded here only so the gate program can quote the pre-registered number for continuity; the graded condition remains the RELATIVE test (>=5% better than same-sample constant velocity, or >=3 of 4 pre-registered motion strata)
errata.g5_strata_definition: 4 strata = quartiles of DEV |V| on the frozen gate frames; identical membership for every model because it depends only on observed velocity; 'won' means >=5% lower L1 than constant velocity in that stratum
